description: This file defines the RouteParserInterface for the Slim Framework, outlining the methods related to URL and route path generation, including relative URLs, URLs with base paths, and full URLs for named routes.

classes.name: RouteParserInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for generating route URLs within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: relativeUrlFor
methods.description: Builds a relative URL path for a named route, excluding the base path.

methods.name: urlFor
methods.description: Builds a URL including the base path for a named route.

methods.name: fullUrlFor
methods.description: Generates a fully qualified URL for a named route using a UriInterface object.
